description: Published openings on one company's public Recruitee careers site (pass its subdomain, e.g. bunq for bunq.recruitee.com). Title, department, city, country, employment type, remote flag, publish time, apply link, and salary when the company publishes it. One company per call. Related tools on this server, for a different need: jobs_arbeitnow when you need job openings from the Arbeitnow public job board API; jobs_ashby when you need open roles from one company's public Ashby job board. Price: $0.002 per successful call, paid with x402 (USDC on Base, Solana and 10 more networks); failed calls are not charged.

company.description: Recruitee subdomain of the company, e.g. bunq
